ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent that executes risk-adjusted yield rebalancing strategies across decentralized finance protocols using smart contracts.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Contracts and DeFi: Practical blockchain applications and decentralized financial tools.
ideas.title: AgenticDeFi Yield Rebalancer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines autonomous agents with DeFi protocols, echoing winning patterns from AI-agent hackathons where automated execution was a key judge priority.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized application enabling academic institutions to issue verifiable credentials that students can prove possession of without revealing underlying grades.
ideas.problem_statement: Blockchain and Web3: Decentralized applications, on-chain verification, digital identity, and trust infrastructure.
ideas.title: ZK-Cred: Zero-Knowledge Student Credential Verifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps directly into the trust infrastructure track and implements hard engineering via ZK proofs, scoring high on technical difficulty and real-world applicability.
